name: Websinoo Speed Optimizer
author: websinoo

sections.description:
Websino Speed Optimizer is a lightweight and efficient plugin designed to significantly improve your WordPress site’s speed. This plugin includes:

  • 🚀 Disabling unnecessary scripts like emojis & embeds
  • 🛠 Increasing PHP memory limit for better performance
  • 🔥 Enabling Gzip compression and browser caching
  • 🎯 Lazy loading images for faster page speed
  • ⛔ Disabling Heartbeat API to reduce CPU usage
  • 💾 Optimizing the database by removing revisions and transient data

This plugin is an all-in-one solution for WordPress performance optimization, helping to improve page load times and overall user experience.

Support

For support and feature requests, visit Websino.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin and upload it to the /wp-content/plugins/websino-speed-optimizer/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Enjoy a faster WordPress site! 🚀
sections.faq:
Will this plugin work with caching plugins?

Yes! Websino Speed Optimizer is compatible with popular caching plugins like WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, and LiteSpeed Cache.

Is this plugin safe for my website?

Absolutely! The plugin only optimizes WordPress settings and does not make permanent changes to core files.

Can I disable specific optimizations?

Currently, all optimizations are enabled by default. Future updates may include a settings panel for more customization.
